about_the_game:
Watara is a life simulation game enriched with adventure and exploration. You’ll build a farm from the ground up, form meaningful relationships with villagers, uncover ancient mysteries, and interact with nature spirits known as Watapets.

With a dynamic time system, seasonal changes, and evolving daily life, Watara invites players to experience a world where nature, history, and personal growth are deeply intertwined.

Features:

  • Build and grow your farm across changing seasons

  • Interact with diverse villagers with unique personalities and stories

  • Explore ancient ruins and mystical places hidden in nature

  • Raise and bond with magical creatures called Watapets

  • Dynamic day/night and seasonal cycles that affect gameplay

  • Beautifully hand-crafted 2D environments with atmospheric music

  • Inspired by the local traditions and spiritual beliefs of the Nusantara archipelago

short_description: Watara is a cozy farming and adventure sim where you grow crops, raise animals, explore mythological ruins, battle ancient spirits, and rebuild a lost kingdom using the power of five elemental forces.
